title: Keep independent analytics totals separate from ordered cohort conversion

source.ref: Owner analytics dashboard and user-flow request, 2026-11-13.

detail: Independent event totals no longer imply ordered drop-off; anonymous visits and signed-in launches remain distinct populations. Unavailable attendance and page speed remain unknown instead of zero. New focused regressions failed before implementation; existing probes were preserved. Implementation proof does not assert production activation.
